### Irish whiskey aged in two barrels

# Glendalough Double Barrel

![Bottle of Glendalough Double Barrel Irish Whiskey featuring a gold-hued spirit, a dark green label with a gold figure, and a wood-topped cork stopper.](https://us.glendaloughdistillery.com/wp-content/uploads/doub-ebarrle-web.png)

Our Double Barrel Irish Whiskey begins its maturation process in flame-charred ex Bourbon American oak. It is finished in Oloroso casks from Montilla, a small town found in the rolling hills of the Spanish countryside.

We choose the bodega, the liquid, the casks and the cooper in this region of Spain to deliver a terroir-driven sense of this land , encapsulated in the liquid when we put our whiskey in these slow-toasted casks for aging.

These specially selected casks combined with expert liquid finishing, deliver a rich and complex flavour to our Double Barrel Irish Whiskey.

[FIND NOW](https://us.glendaloughdistillery.com/locator)

#### Tasting Notes

###### **NOSE**

Rich with notes of dark fruit, cherry, raisin, fig, and Christmas pudding.

###### **TASTE**

Sweet and smooth, with hints of butterscotch, honey and peppercorn, dried fruit, maraschino cherries, and brown sugar.

###### **FINISH**

Hints of ginger spices, and a touch of almond and earthiness.

![whiskey double barrel article](https://us.glendaloughdistillery.com/wp-content/uploads/whiskey_double_barrel_article.avif)
